data.gender_notes: Sora is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Japanese, Sora means 'sky' or 'heaven'. It is derived from the Proto-Japanese word *su-ra, which means 'to soar, fly, or float'. In Christian contexts, Sora can symbolize the spiritual realm, the heavens, or the divine. The name Sora carries the meaning “Soaring, floating, or sky” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sora usually hope their child will grow to embody soaring, floating, or sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting the boundless expanse of the spiritual world and the infinite love of God.
data.etymology: Sora belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soaring, floating, or sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sora total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
